input.notes: Tick ladder: 6 at y=100 px, 4 at y=226, 2 at y=352, 0 at y=477.5 (dashed line), -2 at y=603, -4 at y=729, -6 at y=855; gap between neighbouring printed ticks = 2 units = 125.8 px, so 1 px = 0.0159 units. Exposure x-axis runs from block 1 at x=230 to block 90 at x=866, i.e. only ~7 px per block, so individual last-block markers overlap heavily; I therefore read the fitted double-exponential curves at their right-hand terminus (block 90) as the late-exposure level for each group, and took the error half-length from the visible SE whiskers on the last few blocks.
